definitions.explanation: A point or period in time; an occasion.
Used after verbs or adjectives to mean 'when' or 'at the time that.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Cold drinks taste good when it's hot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I played a lot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}して→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please consult me when you're in trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I was really happy at that time.

notes:
WRITING:
Can be written as {時|とき} with kanji, but often written in hiragana, especially when used as a grammatical conjunction.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- V(plain) + とき (when doing V)
- V(た) + とき (after doing V / when V happened)
- A(い) + とき (when A)
- N + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + とき (at the time of N)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧とき (at that time)
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧とき (at this time)
- ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧とき (at that time - past)
- ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (always, at any time)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- とき vs. ⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧
  - とき: general temporal "when"
  - ⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧: conditional "in the case that"
